title: the Cthulhu mythos
audit_comment: THE CTHULHU MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round eight, print pp. 43-48: fifteen beings (Cthulhu, Azathoth, Cthugha, the Byakhee servants of Hastur, the Flame Creatures, the Deep Ones, Hastur the Unspeakable, the Great Race, Ithaqua the Wind Walker, the Mi-Go, Nyarlathotep the crawling chaos, the Primordial Ones, the Shoggoths, Shub-Niggurath, Yog-Sothoth), the Old Ones lore with the name-speaking and nature-warning doctrines, and the two artifacts: the Elder Sign and the Necronomicon. Zero registry defs touched; the floor holds at 995. The flagged eyeball cells: the Cthulhu charisma (both voices read 7 with the minus lost in the scrawl - pinned 7), the Cthugha ability line (IA-garbled, the Termux fold pinned: I 12, W 18, CH 1), the Azathoth size (the printed inconceivable, sentinel), the Nyarlathotep size (the printed Variable, sentinel), the Primordial One move (the printed 18/12 slash) and the Mi-Go size (the IA 8 feet against the Termux 8 inches).

banner.title: the Cthulhu mythos - the D&DG walk round eight, print pp. 43-48: fifteen beings from Cthulhu the dreamer in sunken R lyeh to Yog-Sothoth the key and guardian of the gate, the seven monster races of the Old Ones, and the two artifacts - the Elder Sign and the Necronomicon - across four planes.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 044-049; the second printing); the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (deities-demigods-1st-print, djvu.txt + djvu.xml word geometry at 600dpi, segs 43-48). The adjudications: the psionic classes by word geometry (the 10px single bars of Cthulhu, Cthugha, Hastur, Shub-Niggurath and Yog-Sothoth; Byakhee the 54px IV, Ithaqua the IV, the Flame Creature V, Nyarlathotep V, Azathoth VI), the monster psionic point scores (Great Race 280, Mi-Go 90, Primordial One 206 - the R853 Math 200 precedent), the Mi-Go size (the IA geometry 8 feet against the Termux 8 inches), the Primordial One move (the printed 18/12 slash in both voices - flagged), the Cthulhu charisma (both voices read 7, the minus lost - pinned 7, flagged for the physical-copy eyeball), and the Cthugha ability line (IA scrawl, the Termux fold pinned, flagged).
